android_mechanism: Cache/data structure grows without bound; fix bounds the retained data
bug_description: The search-history store persists every keyword as its own preference key and never bounds the number of entries. The history grows without limit, the history component renders an ever-growing ForEach, and preferences storage/flush volume grows with every search.
fix_summary: History is kept as a single ordered JSON list capped at the 20 most recent keywords.

test_oracle.definition: Pss of the app process after the workload, from the periodic smaps_rollup snapshots in memory/.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: 500000 vs 2000 retained entries; 2.30G vs 2.47M instructions on the read path

mechanism_oracle.definition: Number of history entries retained after 60 searches, size of the preferences file, and CPU/time to render the history component when the search page opens.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed retains 60+ entries and growing render/storage cost; fixed retains 20. unfixed history-component build cost and preferences size > fixed.

reproduction: git -C hosts/interviewapp checkout case/interviewapp_search_history_unbounded/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/interviewapp checkout case/interviewapp_search_history_unbounded/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
